decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a low-investment accessory with little public commitment, so dropping it would cost little, but it is cheap to keep in the parts catalog and nothing indicates it failed.
The box trailer line has several models, was featured on the home page in both years, and is central to the firm's core trailer business, so heavy investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.
The car transporter line embodies substantial development and tooling investment, and any weak results can be attributed to temporary market conditions such as the pandemic and material shortages.
The low-bed series is a multi-model line promoted on the home page, so withdrawing it would write off a visible core investment.
The high cover series is a multi-model line publicly featured on the home page and tied to the firm's core range, so commitment favors persistence.
This box trailer series was prominently shown on the home page, which creates public commitment, though its overlap with B makes consolidation slightly more likely.
